privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.controllerIntro: The controller of your personal data is:
privacyPage.dataIntro: We process the personal data you provide through the contact form:
privacyPage.purposeBody: We process your data solely for the purpose of handling your enquiry. The legal basis is your consent, given when you submitted the contact form. You may withdraw consent at any time.
privacyPage.retentionBody: We retain your data for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry, but no longer than 12 months from the last communication.
rightsItems: request access to your personal data
withdraw your consent at any time
privacyPage.rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us at
privacyPage.authorityBody: The supervisory authority is the Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ), Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, Czech Republic.
privacyPage.cookiesBodyNoAnalytics: This site uses no tracking cookies or analytics tools.
privacyPage.cookiesBodyWithAnalytics: This site uses analytics cookies only after you give consent. You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing cookies in your browser.
